public_body: East Longmeadow Police Chief Search Committee
overall: The AG found the Committee violated the OML by convening its March 9 executive session with an insufficiently detailed motion, and by taking a secret-ballot vote on February 26; ordered compliance, minute revision, and ballot release.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Committee convened in executive session at its March 9 meeting without an appropriate motion and roll call vote.
allegations.key_passage: Accordingly, we find that the Committee violated the law by failing to provide sufficient detail about the anticipated executive session.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Committee voted by secret ballot to select three final candidates during its February 26 executive session.
allegations.key_passage: The Open Meeting Law explicitly prohibits votes taken by secret ballot.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, extended to all future search committees created by the Town Council.
Revise the February 26 executive session minutes to reflect each member's vote and release all three rounds of ballots to the public within 30 days.
The Committee may not rely on the Open Meeting Law as the basis for continuing to withhold the March 9 executive session minutes.
remedy_passage: We order immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
